NOTE
**Ready for review**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description filled in with "Fixes: #40051" and how it was tested |
| ✅  | Screenshots added (in a comment, not in the description) |
| ⚠️  | Self-review checklist is in the description, but "Strings and tooltips" and "Corner cases" are unchecked |
| ℹ️  | The issue asks for before/after screenshots at different sizes. The two images in the comment may not show both. |
| ℹ️  | Issue #40051 has "help wanted". The earlier claimant was unassigned on 2026-09-13, and their PR #40052 is still open and stale (same file). |
| ℹ️  | CI passed, and there are no conflicts. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the feedback and already knows the PR's history.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign @laurynmm. They can decide how to handle the older PR #40052.

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this? The author has added screenshots and testing notes.
```
